blinding: No B constructors/accounts/readings or critics opened before this author freeze.
assumptions: A and B are opaque distinct endpoints; X is an opaque entity; K(X) is one unbound relation over A/B.
P and Q are opaque edge predicates. Their extensions are unspecified, not chosen to avoid contradiction.
Exact-whole dictionary was authored exploratorily after exposure, so cost and completeness do not select meaning.
Term occurrences sharing a spelling preserve one value. Repeated endpoint occurrences are actual argument sources, not noun filler.
Binary relation reference chooses the two latest relation productions, including equal denotations, with older first; it never means two latest distinct denotations.
Composition R then S denotes pairs (a,c) with some b such that R(a,b) and S(b,c). It is not an event sequence.
ASSERT is description of the relation object in the record, not a claim that every mathematically named pair must hold in an independently known world.
No formal decomposition is derived here; every raw whole is paid.
No f84/f84r/f116v, images, reserves, admissions or external sources accessed.

ZL/RF are visible obligations with unresolved exact wholes, not preferred-reader repairs or independent leaves.
